'''Bony hutta toads''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Toad/Legends|toad]] with an evenly-spaced grid of mismatched horns and bumps on their backs. [[City/Legends|Cities]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] were often compared to the backs of bony hutta toads.<ref name="FaDCR" />
